description: Revised 2026-10-27 after real eval runs. This capture is a multi-paragraph rant about Zuckerberg/Meta's robotics push — mostly venting, restating already-known events (Meta's humanoid plans, Llama, the $65B spend). The original case treated it as one blanket drop/keep decision, but fan-out applies to opinion too: buried in the rant is one specific, falsifiable prediction (Llama loses its open-weight lead to Chinese labs within 2025) that does clear the non-obvious-claim bar, plus two legitimate already-reported hardware facts (Meta's and Apple's robotics pushes) worth extracting as factual items. The failure mode to actually catch: keeping the whole rant verbatim as one undifferentiated opinion item (the mocking tone, not a thesis) rather than fanning out and mining the one real claim.
